localizedValues.name: S1 - Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The reservation Picnic Shelter is one of two shelters in the park on the east end and across the creek. Shelter has its own large parking lot and has vehicle access for unloading and loading equipment and food at the Shelter (then all vehicles must park up in the parking lot). A beautiful quiet area with eight tables in the shelter and eight out along its own beachfront. The area has a joining soccer area, swing set area and horseshoe pits. The shelter has two wood stoves and an electrical outlet. The swimming area within the reservation areas is within the marked bouy line. Please note that dogs and alcohol are not permitted.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
